# Trace the original physical-support construction for all 46 North Slope components

Parent: #1202. Bounded engineering child, one PR. This is engineering-first investigation, not a geography/source-only research job or a repair authorization.

## Problem and exact boundary

Merged #1300 (`bec82842ad5d9cf07e38a78395df8d5e7a6f4591`) demonstrates two local construction contradictions in the complete North Slope family. Original104 `comparison.py:152` computes `candidate.difference(footprint)`; a retained resulting witness can lie outside the candidate. This establishes a reproducible construction/predicate discrepancy at those exact points. It does **not** establish that Atlas is missing dry land, that every residual is roundoff, that refine-remote caused this discrepancy, or that a whole gap can be filled.

Exact complete family: `gap-source-batch:b2e7623d26b3b92538d62765`; operational batch `gap-operational-batch:596e1d071f5d90be10e3e8ed`. Keep all46 components:28 numeric siblings (2 local contradictions,22 retained unresolved,4 original-replay mismatches) and18 nonnumeric siblings. One full current contact: `atlas:physical:01966024a7da3c19f62b` (North Slope reference adaptation). Whole-family recorded impact is802,137,921.0418996m²; this is not approved missing-land area. Preserve209 original query relations, all source/container/offset fields, source-relative area/status/date/precision/invalid/seam limits and nonnumeric context.

## Required implementation and acceptance

1. **Complete ordinary custody first.** Consume existing immutable whole input bodies, complete current candidate reconstruction, all46 full context/contact records and full209 query relations. Preserve original encoded/decoded SHA, mode/OID, source/date/role/terms and native source-record/container/periodic-frame bindings. Use existing whole-byte codecs/aliases and ordinary caps. No hash-only source replacement, new online source query/download, source/member omission or new generic reader framework. New scope/config must name all46, not only the two demonstrations.
2. **Freeze the literal method before executions.** Retain whole original104 operator bytes (`f9c226add23a37a39bf7fd34f5d8bdcb34a8d276b331fabf59bf9867b6f84bfe`), original support reconstruction semantics, all transitive executed local modules/configs and exact source/input closure. Execute the unmodified `alternating_support` function with a narrowly scoped observation hook or equivalently authenticated exact instrumentation whose method/output equivalence is demonstrated. Retain whole values/pointsets for every original query piece, ordered L1–L4 input list and union, every alternating land/water intermediate, exterior, footprint, final missing/extra/overlap and three hierarchy differences. Do not alter coordinates, precision, ordering, validity rules or geometry containers to obtain agreement.
3. **Two complete scoped executions.** Freeze complete producer/input/import closure before two actual full46 runs at the same committed code. Preserve commands, actual runtime/session/time/outcome evidence, all failures, whole outputs and whole-file equality. Byte-identical final scientific bodies may be delivered once only after independently comparing both complete retained trees; distinct truthful run receipts must bind every body. No world/native regeneration. Final full6 support+3 hierarchy mappings must compare canonically against accepted original rows for every sibling; any discrepancy remains explicit original-replay-mismatch unknown. No old-attributed contradiction/probe claim from mismatching outputs.
4. **Bounded diagnosis with unknowns intact.** Localize the two demonstrated contradictions to exact captured construction stages and preserve every other sibling/residue. Where needed use the unchanged exact-predicate helper/caps for original vertices or certified rational triangle centroids; unsupported/invalid/nontriangle/numerical cases remain unknown. A point witness is not whole-polygon/partition certification. Report smallest supported next engineering or source prerequisite; no nearest-neighbor assignment, absent-water=dryland, epsilon suppression, snapping, buffer, simplification, MakeValid, precision-grid change, territorial affiliation or speculative fill.
5. **Meaningful production-path controls.** Cover complete46/28+18 membership and foreign/duplicate/omitted sibling rejection; missing/changed/reordered query piece and source/container/frame binding; exact valid-simple difference, near-collinear reproduction, mixed/contact/zero-area, invalid-source/candidate and operation failure; exact unchanged stage tracing vs ordinary operator outputs; authentic rehashed retained mapping mismatch/signed-zero/geometry-container drift stays unknown; exact helper caps/unsupported ring preserved. Corruption controls must hit the intended production branch, not an unrelated stale hash. Preserve full directed results and executed code hashes.
6. **Final complete evidence and outcome.** Run actual standard ordinary admission and scope checks after outputs exist, then distinct substantive source/geometry/code/release review on exact PR head/issue/body. Final full-byte/mode merged readback and own cache/claim/checkout lifecycle are required before closure. Reconcile every criterion, unknown and remaining parent obligation. This child can close after complete stage-capture/diagnosis even if a repair is still unsupported; parent #1202 remains open.

## Measured existing input closure and budget

Private precreation inventory proves a conservative existing complete closure, without new large copies or operators:

-179 existing original/scientific/context/routing ordinary inputs:182,875,702 encoded bytes; includes complete original candidate/source restoration and native archive custody.
-45 complete accepted first numeric scientific products:39,673,399 encoded bytes (all complete pointsets,28 selected summaries are not substitutes).
-Whole original code/config/report, current full contact geography part, recipe/source metadata/report, original USAADM2 and attribution/catalogue bodies bring the measured existing total to **237,274,443 encoded bytes / 246 descriptors**. Maximum declared decoded single body **28,911,831 bytes**.
-Remaining before new code/output/control/review bodies: **31,161,013 bytes** under268,435,456 aggregate;512 descriptors and33,554,432 encoded/decoded per-body limits remain unchanged. This is an input preflight, not final admission or an assertion that ungenerated outputs fit. Measure the final whole closure; use existing lossless partition/alias support if needed, never cap waivers.

Original numeric full28 siblings span20 diagnosis files, while the two prior demonstration pins only cover two files. All45 accepted numerical products are retained here to preserve complete references and avoid incomplete witness custody. Scoped physical rows span33 existing containing shards (32,629,381 encoded bytes); selected46 packed rows total714,014 bytes and209 query relations. No new geometry operators were run to prepare these counts.

## Source provenance and non-goals

Original administrative source identity `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B80059195101619` is available through merged original-source corpus `1bf4bb01d76a76953d4a11308f5af2dd50fe3365`: ordinary encoded original USAADM2 gzip2,476,897 bytes/SHA`fe2128f4a5c164c9a9f58a6321af446782f6a689e4d5d9452e5967047c1958c9`; mandatory decoded whole7,938,450 bytes/SHA`16249e8d795aaded6a72910a8c72115a073814b25ee902d61ccc9a9490c6641a`,3233 features. Registry claims represented2018/Public Domain; preserve actual attribution and uncertainty, not new source authority.

The contact records a North Slope administrative reference adapted using RESOLVE407 Arctic coastal tundra. Original `refine-remote.py`, semantic-source metadata and semantic report are retained as provenance. This work does not execute that historical processing recipe, reproduce its lost pre-adaptation inputs or approve ecological/administrative/dated-water truth. Full historical refine/RESOLVE/lake execution custody is a separate next experiment if this trace supports it. The literal current problem is the original104 GSHHG-relative construction discrepancy. Original GSHHG2.3.7/2017 release, heterogeneous observation dates, registration/resolution, invalid/native seam and licensing limitations stay explicit.

Available exact runtime: Python3.12.14/NumPy2.3.5/Shapely2.1.2/GEOS3.13.1 (accepted original runtime matches); preserve whole executable/extension/library pins and actual commands rather than treating versions alone as identity.

## Coordination and private readiness evidence

Fresh complete open issue/PR scan:619 records; no exact46 component/family/contact/stable-member collision. Broad existing obligations #456/#458 (Arctic and Subarctic America) and #887 (AAFC territorial clipping) remain separate and unclaimed in fresh full comment reads; this job grants none of their regional/source/import approvals. Closed #1205 addresses282 Matanuska-Susitna components/4 different contacts, with canonical released reservation, and is not this North Slope family. Dependencies #1261/#1298/#1300 are actually closed; original #1202 worldwide repair/prevention acceptance remains unfinished.

Precreation evidence is outside author checkouts: `.cache/north-slope46-engineering-preflight-20261007/`. Full rooted preparation packet SHA`6291414e14f1d109156804f8603cb33510ce314e24cdc7d304555c65070f0daa`; prior complete operation trace179,553 bytes/SHA`7dfc0065cf8b5c95f4b9a8450d2df3eb1fed9cd518ca54808f0085c74ec1d871`. These private expected hashes are not substituted for ordinary machine baseline pins.
